purpose: Teach: かから/そうして/背筋/座ら/変えれ/ぼろ/ふら/きょう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の改装、あまりお金がかからないの、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the store renovation didn't end up costing much, did it.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost thinking aloud. Warm approval threaded underneath. Eyes on Aoi with genuine interest. Pace unhurried, like she's noticing something good and wants Aoi to feel it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、そうしてお店、お客様で賑わうようになったのね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And now the store's so full of customers. It's really come alive.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Slight lift at the midpoint, as if watching something beautiful unfold. Quiet delight in Aoi's success. Tender but not saccharine — the confidence of someone who already knew this would happen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お背筋伸ばしてお仕事すると疲れにくいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: When you keep your posture straight while working, it doesn't tire you out as much.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact care, the way you offer small kindnesses without making them a big deal. Eyes on Aoi's shoulders. Not lecturing — just sharing what works. Slight exhale, like she's learned this herself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、座らないでお店を回ると元気でるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When you move around the shop instead of sitting, you have so much more energy.
lines.style: Bright realization, like she's watching it happen in real time. Encouragement without pushiness. Quick pace, slightly more animated than before. A small smile in the voice — she's delighted by Aoi's natural rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お皿の配置を変えればもっと素敵になるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: If you rearranged where the plates go, it would be even lovelier.
lines.style: Thoughtful, visioning. Warm appreciation for the space and Aoi's care of it. Gentle suggestion, not correction. Slight upward lilt — inviting Aoi to see what she sees.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のエプロン、もうぼろぼろね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That apron you wear at the shop is really falling apart now, isn't it.
lines.style: Dry observation with affection underneath. Light, almost amused — the way you tease someone you're looking out for. Not harsh. A setup for care masquerading as wry comment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お疲れの日はふらふらしないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: On days when you're tired, don't push yourself too hard.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Underlying worry kept soft. Direct but tender — the voice of someone who notices when you're running on fumes. Slight exhale at the end, like she's said this because it matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、きょうのお客様、お洒落だったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer today was so stylish, didn't you think.
lines.style: Warm observation, sharing a moment. Light, easy delight in noticing something together. Slight conspiratorial lean — inviting Aoi into the pleasantness of small moments. Genuinely curious what Aoi saw.
